The same admissible record also limits the claim: the fraud dispute review slice is 1.3 percentage points below the warning threshold, prior approval predates the current retrieval configuration change and eval batch, and the manual-monitoring comment is not an approved mitigation. On that record, the supportable position is that certification is defensible only on a constrained basis if the packet itself squarely treats the fraud slice weakness as a current limitation that must be disclosed under policy, rather than treating prior approval or informal monitoring as substitutes.
